races.paceDynamic: Bamako Beach and Absoluteassignment are the confirmed front runners who will set the early fractions in this 13-runner maiden. With both leaders having shown they can sustain their pace efforts (Bamako Beach second over 7f, Absoluteassignment placed efforts), they should create an honest gallop without collapsing. The majority of this field are hold-up horses including the highest-rated The Publican's Son and Starred, meaning the pace-setters won't face early pressure but will get picked off if they weaken. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can time their challenge late against tired leaders.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Bamako Beach and Absoluteassignment maintain steady fractions without burning out
scenarios.body: The honest pace will set up perfectly for the hold-up brigade to mount late challenges, with class horses like The Publican's Son and Starred having every chance to show their superior ratings. Quality prevails over tactics in a well-run race.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front runners steal march
scenarios.trigger: If the two leaders get away with soft fractions due to lack of early pressure
scenarios.body: Bamako Beach and Absoluteassignment could maintain their advantage to the line, with the hold-up horses left with too much to do in the closing stages. The 7f trip suits both pace-setters' profiles.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders fold tamely leaving a tactical mess
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the 2f pole with positioning crucial, favouring horses who can adapt their tactics and have natural speed to deploy. Late pace becomes everything.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise package emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the newcomer Glasarmi or an unfancied runner shows unexpected improvement
scenarios.body: A lightly-raced horse with untapped potential could exploit the tactical setup while the market leaders underperform. Fresh legs triumph over exposed form.

races.paceDynamic: Loch Gamhna will lead from the start with no other confirmed front runners to challenge early, setting a steady tempo that won't drain his reserves. The prominent runners Kalir, Casamorati, and Leeward will track within striking distance but won't apply significant pressure in the opening stages. With a large field of 16 runners and only one natural leader, the pace will be moderate rather than searching, creating a tactical affair where positioning becomes crucial. This sustainable tempo strongly favours prominent runners and hold-up horses with finishing kicks over front runners who would normally benefit from a stronger gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Kalir or Casamorati can secure ideal tracking positions behind Loch Gamhna.
scenarios.body: The moderate pace allows them to conserve energy while staying close to the action, then strike in the final two furlongs when the leaders tire. Their proven ability at this distance range gives them the edge over hold-up horses who may find too much to do.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes even more sedate than expected and horses get strung out.
scenarios.body: Strong finishers like Satoyama and Stellar View get the perfect setup to unleash late runs from the back of the field. The combination of Joseph O'Brien's tactics and patient riding creates the ideal scenario for his hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Loch Gamhna Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Loch Gamhna gets completely uncontested fractions and kicks clear turning for home.
scenarios.body: His prominent style becomes effectively front-running as he steals a march on the field before they can respond. The lack of early pressure means he has enough left to resist late challengers in a staying battle.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Newcomer Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the lightly-raced Saliba or Will You Stop show significantly improved form on debut for new connections.
scenarios.body: Their unknown quantities spring a shock with superior class that hasn't been exposed in previous runs. The steady pace suits unexposed types who can quicken when others are at their limit.

The large field of 16 runners increases the chance of traffic problems for hold-up horses who need clear runs.

races.paceDynamic: Snapretend will control this race from the front with minimal pressure, as the only confirmed leader against prominent runners Contorsion, Denim And Diamonds and Jannah Star who prefer to sit close rather than challenge early. The steady tempo will suit the hold-up brigade of Moody, Floresta, Nuit, Dippedinmoonlight, Tamam Desert and Bay Colony who can track the pace and unleash finishing kicks. With one uncontested leader setting reasonable fractions over this staying trip on yielding ground, this race shape strongly favours closers with tactical speed who can produce sustained rallies in the final three furlongs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Snapretend gets an easy lead and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows the front-runner to dictate ideal fractions and prove hard to peg back when quickening off steady pace. Joseph O'Brien's runner has the class edge at OR 99 and recent Leopardstown form suggests readiness to capitalise.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses time their runs perfectly in the straight
scenarios.body: The generous pace allows closers like Moody and Floresta to unleash devastating finishes with their superior ratings (OR 100-101). Multiple horses converge late with the strongest stayer prevailing in a driving finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Victory
scenarios.trigger: If Contorsion or Jannah Star shadow Snapretend and strike approaching the furlong pole
scenarios.body: The O'Brien stable runners use their positional advantage to collar the leader while avoiding traffic problems that could hamper the closers. Fresh legs after breaks give them the edge in a tactical battle.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Snapretend sets overly slow fractions and multiple horses charge simultaneously
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish with horses fanning wide, favouring those with natural pace rather than pure stamina. The moderate pace negates the staying advantage and creates an open finish.

Apercu, Lady Lilac and She's A Nation will track the leaders in prominent positions, while the hold-up quartet of Lemsairbat, Abbey Actress, Sindria and Um Wadi will need the pace to collapse late. scenarios.label: A

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders go too fast early and tie up in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The strong early gallop sets up perfectly for closers with a devastating late kick. Hold-up horses sweep past the weakening pace-setters.

scenarios.label: D

This creates a comfortable early tempo for Ramair, who can dictate terms without pressure from other leaders. The large field of hold-up horses including Femme Beauty, Neon Eyes, Aurora Mist and Beau Army will settle towards the rear, creating traffic problems on the 1m circuit at Gowran Park. scenarios.trigger: If the large field causes significant interference turning for home
scenarios.body: Ramair's uncontested lead becomes unassailable as the field bunches behind and struggles for room. The front runner stays on strongly in the testing conditions.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Late Closer Finds Clear Water
scenarios.trigger: If splits open wide in the final furlong and pace collapses
scenarios.body: A horse with proven finishing kick gets a dream passage through beaten horses to collar the leaders late. This requires perfect timing and positioning.

races.paceDynamic: Young Churchill will likely lead this field with limited early pressure, as the prominent runners Carvalhal, Verhoyen and Shahada Ace are all capable of tracking rather than forcing the pace. This sets up a steady tempo through the early stages before the large field of hold-up horses look to make their moves turning for home. The lone leader scenario typically creates a strong gallop from the 3-furlong pole as the back markers need to make ground. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can quicken off the moderate early tempo, particularly those with proven finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: A

scenarios.trigger: If Young Churchill leads uncontested and the pace stays steady until the turn
scenarios.body: The large field of closers gets the perfect setup to unleash late runs, with the moderate early tempo suiting those who need time to wind up. Fresh finishers from the pack will swamp the early leaders in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B

scenarios.trigger: If one of the early positioned horses can stalk Young Churchill and outkick the closers
scenarios.body: Carvalhal or Verhoyen travel smoothly behind the leader and have enough left to hold off the late charge from the back markers. The race becomes a battle between early speed and late pace.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Young Churchill goes too slow and the field stays bunched turning in
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace creates a cavalry charge where positioning and racing room become crucial, potentially suiting horses drawn well who can get first run. Traffic problems will hinder several fancied runners.

scenarios.label: D
